ajeya_raj.document_text:
My name is Ajeya Raj and I am an individual living with a C4 level spinal cord injury, resulting in a 100% disability. Since 2006, I have relied on a motorized wheelchair, operated using my chin, and I require assistance with all activities of daily living. Despite these challenges, I successfully manage the Food and Beverage as well as social media operations for Chandigarh Spinal Rehab, a rehabilitation institute in Chandigarh dedicated to supporting individuals with brain and spinal cord injuries.
As the sole breadwinner of my family and coming from a humble background, I strive to set a positive example for those around me. 
In addition to my professional responsibilities, I am also an accomplished athlete and an International Boccia Player. I have proudly earned eight medals at the national level and represented 5 times India in Boccia and am diligently training in preparation for the upcoming Paralympics in 2028.
My journey reflects resilience, determination, and a commitment to making a difference in the lives of others, both through my work and my athletic pursuits.

anjali_devi.document_text:
Anjali  
International Para Athlete | Boccia – BC3 Category  
Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, India
I am Anjali, an international para athlete from Mandi, Himachal Pradesh. I compete in the BC3 category of Boccia and have won multiple medals at both national and international levels. I hold the distinction of being the first international gold medalist in Boccia for India.
In 2018, I sustained a cervical spinal cord injury in a car accident, which resulted in permanent wheelchair use. Following four years of bed rest, I began rehabilitation at Chandigarh Spinal Rehab in November 2022. It was there that I was introduced to Boccia by senior player Ajeya Raj. I participated in my first National Championship in February 2023.
It has now been three years since I began playing Boccia. With the continued support of Boccia India and Chandigarh Spinal Rehab, I remain committed to the sport and am currently training with the aim of winning a medal at the Paralympic Games.

jatin_kushwah.document_text:
This summary outlines the Boccia sports career of Jatin Kumar Kushwaha, a para-athlete from Agra, India.
Career Beginnings and National Success
   Jatin, who lives with muscular dystrophy, began his Boccia journey after being inspired by the Indian Association of Muscular Dystrophy in Solan.
  He made his competitive debut at the 7th National Boccia Championship in February 2023, where he won gold in the individual category and bronze in pairs.
 Since then, Jatin has maintained a streak of success in national championships, winning gold medals in both individual and pairs categories at the 8th (Gwalior), 9th (Vizag), and 10th (Ahmedabad) National Championships.
International Representation
 Jatin represented India at the Hangzhou 2022 Asian Para Games, an experience he noted as crucial to his growth as a player.
  He achieved a significant milestone at the 2024 Manama World Boccia Challenger series in Bahrain, where he won his first international medals: a bronze in the individual category and a silver in the pairs category.
Training and Recognition
  Jatin, who competes in the BC-4 category, often partners with Pooja Gupta from Haryana for pairs competitions.
  His achievements have garnered significant media coverage and local recognition in Agra.
 Jatin has expressed that his goal is to win medals for his country and serve as a source of inspiration for other people with disabilities.

sachin_chamaria.document_text:
Boccia, a precision ball sport designed specifically for athletes with severe physical disabilities, arrived in India in 2017 under the Para Boccia Sports Welfare Society (India) — now the Boccia Sports Federation of India. For a player in the BC3 category, who needs an assistive ramp and a dedicated ramp assistant to release the ball with consistency and tactical precision, the sport demanded the very qualities Sachin had spent a decade sharpening: focus, patience, and an analytical mind. He took to it quickly, and the results followed just as fast.
Since his first National Championship gold in 2021, Sachin has not relinquished his domestic
crown — six consecutive years as India's National Champion in BC3 (Male) Individual. He has
represented India at World Boccia Challenger and Regional events across Dubai, Poland, Italy, Egypt, Bahrain, Thailand, Australia and Canada, and at the Asian Para Games in Hangzhou, China. Along the way he has trained under international coaches, including Portugal's David Manuel Domingues Henriques, and built a daily practice regimen of several hours — on top of running his own business.
Sachin was honoured with the "Inspirational Sportsman of the Year 2023" award for his
outstanding performance in the field of para-sports, conferred on the occasion of International Paralympic Day, held on 8th October 2023.
Sachin was appointed as Brand Ambassador for the 1st North East Para Games 2024 by the
Paralympic Association of Assam, under the dynamic leadership of its Organising President,
Smt. Riniki Bhuyan Sharma (wife of the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Assam) — a three-year
appointment beginning November 2024.
Adding yet another feather to his cap, Sachin is the only Indian athlete selected by World Boccia to participate in the Seoul 2026 World Boccia Championships, scheduled to be held from 24 August to 4 September 2026 in Seoul, South Korea. He will also represent India at the Cairo 2026 World Boccia Challenger, Egypt, scheduled from 25 to 31 July 2026.

*My Achievements & Recognitions*
I am an artist, para-athlete, innovator, and disability rights advocate who transformed a life-altering childhood electric shock (11000) into a journey of resilience, creativity, national and international  representation. Over the years, my work in art, sports, innovation, and social inclusion has been recognized at national and international levels. 🌍✨
National and International Honours
In 2005, I received the prestigious National Bal Shree Honour for Creative Arts, which was one of the most defining moments of my childhood. This recognition strengthened my belief in the power of creativity and encouraged me to continue pursuing art despite physical challenges. 🎨
In 2008, I was honoured with the National Award for Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (Best Creative Child). This award acknowledged my artistic excellence and my determination to overcome adversity through talent and perseverance.
In 2009, I received the Silver Prize in an International Art Contest on the theme “Egypt in the Eyes of the Children of the World.” This global recognition expanded my artistic vision and inspired me to represent India through cultural expression. 🌏
In 2010, I was selected for the Godfrey Phillips National Bravery Award in the category “Mind of Steel (Girl).” This honour recognized my courage and mental strength in facing life’s challenges with determination and positivity. 💪
Achievements in Art and Education
Art has always been my lifeline and emotional strength. As a Madhubani artist and creative professional, my artworks have received four national awards and one international award. I completed my Bachelor of Fine Arts (B.F.A.), which provided me with formal training and deeper understanding of visual expression. 🎓
Journey in Para Sports – Boccia (BC3 Category)
My sports journey began in January 2024, when I participated in my first competitive Boccia tournament and won a Gold Medal at the International Purple Fest National Boccia Tournament in Goa. This achievement marked the beginning of my identity as a para-athlete. 🏅
In February 2024, I won a Silver Medal in the BC3 Female Individual category at the 8th Boccia National Championship, strengthening my confidence in competitive sports.
In July 2024, I represented India internationally at the World Boccia Challenger in Cairo, Egypt, where I created history by winning two Bronze Medals — one in the BC3 Individual category and another in the BC3 Pair event.
This achievement made me:
✨ The first Indian BC3 female athlete to win an international Boccia medal
✨ A member of India’s first international Boccia pair medal-winning team
In January 2025, I secured two Silver Medals (Individual and Pair) at the 9th Boccia National Championship, continuing my consistent performance at the national level.
In 2025, I again won two Silver Medals at the Purple Fest Federation Cup, followed by two Silver Medals at the 10th Boccia National Championship in 2026, establishing myself as a regular podium finisher in Indian Boccia. 🥈
Innovation and Global Recognition
As a triple amputee, I constantly innovate to make daily life more accessible and independent. I designed a low-cost 3-in-1 wheelchair-mounted device combining an umbrella holder, utility tray, and magnetic mobile stand.
This innovation earned me the International Discovery Award at the Zero Project Conference 2025, recognizing my contribution to practical and inclusive assistive solutions. 💡
Fashion, Inclusion, and Social Representation
In 2024, I became a showstopper at an inclusive fashion event, where I proudly walked the ramp in my wheelchair. This experience symbolized empowerment, confidence, and breaking stereotypes about disability and beauty. 👗✨
Educational Recognition and Social Impact
My life journey has been featured in school textbooks, allowing students across India to learn about resilience, creativity, and determination. This recognition motivates me to continue working as a role model for young generations. 📚
Professional Contribution and Leadership
I currently work as a Brand Ambassador and departmental coordinator, where I manage guest reception responsibilities while also supporting persons with disabilities in accessing government schemes and rehabilitation services Like ADIP, SSA AND RVY . 🌱

vyom_pawa.document_text:
Vyom Pawa – A Journey of Excellence in Boccia
Vyom Pawa's journey in Boccia is a story of determination, resilience, and excellence. Living with cerebral palsy, Vyom discovered Boccia as a sport that perfectly matched his precision, strategy, and unwavering spirit. Through years of dedicated training and hard work, he has grown from a promising national athleteinto one of India's leading young Boccia players.
Vyom first made his mark at the national level by winning the Bronze Medal in the BC1 category at the  National Boccia Championship 2024. Later that year, he represented India at the Bahrain Boccia Challenger 2024, where he received his international BC2 classification and earned valuable world ranking points.
In 2025, Vyom achieved another major milestone by winning the Gold Medal in the BC2 Team Event at the 9th National Boccia Championship held in Visakhapatnam. This victory established him as one of India's top Boccia athletes.
In August 2025, Vyom proudly represented India at the Kazakhstan Boccia Challenger 2025. Competing against some of the best international Boccia players, he delivered an outstanding performance and secured 5th Position, gaining valuable international experience and improving his global standing.
Continuing his remarkable journey, Vyom represented India at the Asian Youth Para Games, Dubai, in December 2025. Wearing the Indian jersey at one of Asia's most prestigious para sporting events was a proud moment for him and reflected his dedication, perseverance, and commitment to excellence.
Vyom continued his winning momentum at the 10th National Boccia Championship held in Ahmedabad, where he won the Gold Medal in the Team Event, further strengthening his reputation as one of India's finest young Boccia players.
Vyom continues to train every day under the guidance of his father, who serves as his coach. Their shared commitment, discipline, and hard work have played a vital role in Vyom's development and success at both the national and international levels.
Major Boccia Achievements
• Bronze Medal – National Boccia Championship 2024 (BC1)
• Represented India – Bahrain Boccia Challenger 2024 (International BC2 Classification)
• Gold Medal – 9th National Boccia Championship 2025, Visakhapatnam (BC2 Team Event)
• Represented India – Kazakhstan Boccia Challenger 2025 (5th Position)
Gold Medal – 1st Boccia purple fest federation cup, goa (BC2 Team Event)
